profile.headline: Frontend Developer | React JS | Next JS
profile.summary:
Front End Developer with more than 4 years of experience in JavaScript development. Specializing on
technologies such as React JS, Redux, HTML5, CSS, SASS, and REST API following agile methodology. I
played a major role in delivering the complete digital transformation of a telecommunications
company. From the R&D phase to the final delivery, I developed user stories, addressed production
defects, resolved gaps, and interfaced with clients by leading live production bridges.
